acceptance: Red first: with only the new key set, diskSignal, the preflight check and the percent guard all read the same floor, through the real `evolve gc` and `evolve loop` entry points
Red first: an old key still works for one release and prints a WARN naming the new key
Red first: setting two different values for the old and new keys is refused with an error that names both
A guard test fails when a second reader of a disk floor appears outside the resolver
fix: Choose one policy key block for the disk floor (a warn level, a launch floor and a percent floor) with one resolver in a leaf package. gcpolicy, looppreflight and the review verb of X13 call that resolver. Keep the old keys as read-only aliases for one release with a WARN, then remove them. Update the policy docs.
